findings.summary: total_seconds = work+10 leaves only 10 s for observer postflight (validate_outputs, verify_bound, full journal accounting) after worker exit; binding.py:188 enforces the equality, observe.py:194 uses it as hard_at.
findings.trigger: Worker finishes within postflight time of work_seconds, or postflight exceeds 10 s at full journal size (prior observer overhead 9.4 s at about one-eighth journal size; scaled estimate about 80 s).
findings.consequence: observer deadline_consumed, status failed, parent incident for a completed 7168-episode run. Fail-closed, no cap loophole.
findings.fix: Add explicit postflight allowance to total_seconds. Requires new package revision (sealed source).

findings.summary: No test drives worker.run() (worker.py:85-150) or observe.main() with stubs; 53 fake tests cover statics, Guard counters, synthetic outputs and producer tamper only.
findings.trigger: Defect in new worker-only code path (constructor/step counters, comparison module, report naming, parent/producer checkpoint branches) on first real run.
findings.fix: Fake-worker integration test via observe.main popen/clock/sleep injection; stubbed ckpt/teacher/_production_rows test of worker.run().

findings.summary: Per-episode gameplay <= 18000 enforced only post-run in terminal; worker enforces only global raw ceiling (worker.py:32, 58).
findings.consequence: Postflight failure after full run (overlaps finding 1). Global raw bound still holds.

findings.summary: parent-execution.json and execution-exit.json are pinned by hash only; contents (raw_observer_exit_code, observer_directly_reaped, registration_sha256) are never read.
findings.trigger: Exit receipt disagrees with producer audit.
findings.fix: Assert exit code 0, direct reap and matching registration SHA in both receipts.

findings.summary: resets=0 declared (also build_registration.py:88) but no reset telemetry is counted.
findings.trigger: Native env reset inside _production_rows (none found in current code paths).
findings.consequence: None under current code; limit is declarative only.
findings.fix: Document, or count resets in Guard.journal.

findings.summary: MPS cap is self-reported by the worker; observe.py:273 checks only the worker's resources.jsonl. RSS is independently sampled via ps in observe.py.
findings.trigger: Worker stops reporting while MPS grows.

findings.summary: Observer re-reads the whole resources.jsonl every loop iteration; quadratic in run length (about 30k rows projected).
findings.consequence: Observer CPU contention; SIGALRM still enforces deadlines.
findings.fix: Accept; observe.py is byte-identical to proven source, so change needs re-proof.

findings.summary: Journal disk growth not budgeted. Prior: 471 MB for 3.85M steps (about 122 B/line). Registered worst case about 129M steps, about 15.7 GB.
findings.fix: Free-space check before launch (about 305 GiB free at review time).

findings.summary: Calibration acceptance checked by hash only; binding.verify_bound checks source acceptance manifest SHA but not its status (launch.py checks status).
findings.consequence: Parent-authored error not caught by code.
findings.fix: Validate calibration acceptance schema and work_seconds equality.

findings.summary: No overshoot allowance. Raw ceiling checked after each event against exact sum 7168 x 18013; overshoot at most one native step (<= 4 frames), already spent and counted.
worker_group_absent is set unconditionally in finally; the claimed blocker does not exist.
